ModMetaData.name: RimTalk - Enhanced Prompt
ModMetaData.author: ruaji
ModMetaData.description:
Enhances RimTalk's health information display with severity levels, detailed descriptions, and pain indicators.
Features: - Shows severity percentages for health conditions - Displays detailed descriptions of injuries and diseases - Indicates pain levels and lethality - Intelligent information scaling based on context level
Requires RimTalk to be installed and loaded before this mod.
